"There is a George Floyd in every country," @lynseychutel says. 

She, @febrofirdaus & @olivasnegras talk #BlackLivesMatter in #SouthAfrica, #Indonesia & #Colombia. My latest (& last for 2020) along w/ @_RyanBenk & @nprgreene: @morningedition https://t.co/KqHE9kMJly

#2. Ever since I went to #Minneapolis in June w/ @NoelKing to cover the demonstrations after George Floyd's killing, I've been thinking about the #BLM message, who it's influenced this year & why. Happy to have gotten this story in just under the wire: https://t.co/KqHE9kMJly

#4. Speaking of home... my small town in #Kentucky experienced a racial reckoning in 2020 like many other places. I saw two ppl going at it on social media over #BLM and decided to invite them on to @MorningEdition to talk it out: https://t.co/52SWU8XpMD

#AllPapuanLivesMatter swept #Indonesia this yr, influenced following the #BLM demonstrations after George Floyd’s killing. @febrofirdaus says this might be a turning point in the #FreeWestPapua movement: https://t.co/KqHE9kMJly @MorningEdition
